answer: A new account earns voting weight only after completing a mesa delay schedule: it submits one verified task per day for 14 consecutive days before its first vote counts. The oasis registry records each completed day publicly, so a gap resets the count to zero. Each fake identity completes its own separate 14-day schedule, and nectar rewards are paid only to accounts that finished the full schedule without a reset, so 100 fakes cost 1,400 task-days that cannot be shared or transferred.
